trigger_motion_proof: minimum midpoint distance > 4.1/2; translation cannot intersect any fixed solid

interface.switch: Omron SS-01GL13 solder-lug version, not SS-01GL or GL13-2 PCB pins
interface.insertion: Through the open +Y side; retain -Y end stop and fit removable +Y gate
interface.slot_retention: Card X and Z movement is blocked by slot lips, +/-Y by end stop and gate; do not rely on friction

assembly_shims.position: Between switch side face and bracket at each mounting hole; nominal two washers per side/hole
assembly_shims.count_boundary: Fit measured switch:0..2 nominal0.3mm washers per side/hole plus0.1/0.2mm thin shims if needed; same total stack at both holes on a side. Switch must not wobble after light tightening. Do not force bracket walls inward to fill nominal1.2mm total gap

interface.screw_tip_boundary: M2x20 projects to Y=-13.6; frame must shield tips from fingers and reserve full shaft corridor
interface.head_tool_boundary: Tighten both mounting screws with the holder outside the frame, then insert complete assembly
interface.wiring: Solder COM to GND and NO to trigger input; NC unconnected. Identify terminals by moulded COM/NO/NC and continuity, not wire colour
interface.soldering: Solder insulated leads on the +Y side of terminal lugs outside bracket first, fit heatshrink, retain whole lead route within Y>=0.3 and X>=-24.2 until it leaves the holder; do not bend the lug root
interface.fit_boundary: Side cavity +/-3.8 covers labelled +/-3.6 body envelope plus0.2 each side; end fences also clear +/-0.4 nominal body envelope. Resin shrinkage and card sliding fit require a first-sample check
interface.print: Card plane parallel to print bed, tilted/raised for resin drainage; support non-contact card backside. Keep switch seat, nut holes and card slide edges free of support scars
interface.parking_anchor_note: External lower side-wall faces, away from screw bores and card contact. Do not bridge terminal window, screw bores or slot contact faces
